scope: Theorem 5.2 (Uniform graph solvability) of the manuscript “Positive scalar curvature forces rational inessentiality” (preprints/Positive-scalar-curvature-forces-rational-inessentiality-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 335 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 dae319c1cc258208), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 23. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let (B, g) be uniformly controlled as above, and let ℓ ∈ C∞ b (B). Fix ε, w, B0, s > 0 and 0 ≤ β < 1. Suppose N is smooth, positive, nondecreasing, constant near zero, and equal to 1 for t ≥ 1/2. Define the quantities in (4.1) and λ(r) = B0(r2 + s2 )β/2 . There is a unique solution in the uniform C2,α class with a uniform band margin to − divg U = λ(r) tan ( ℓ − εf w ) , |ℓ − εf| < πw 2 . (5.2) This solution lies in C∞ b (B), and the band has a positive uniform margin. The metric (4.2) is uniformly controlled and complete. The solution is invariant under every isometry preserving the equation’s data. The following parameter statement will be used below. Fix the reference cover, its metric and nested charts, and the equation parameters ε, w, B0, s, β, N. Let (ga, ℓa) be a jointly smooth family over a finite- dimensional parameter manifold A. For every relatively compact subset V ′ ⋐ V of a parameter chart, assume common constants cV ′ , CV ′ > 0 such that cV ′ gref ≤ ga ≤ CV ′ gref (a ∈ V ′ ), and common bounds in the fixed reference charts for every mixed derivative of the coefficients of ga and of ℓa, including order zero. Then a |→ fa is smooth in every Cj,α b norm, for j ≥ 0 and 0 < α < 1. If A is compact, all mixed derivatives of fa are uniformly bounded and the tangent band has a common positive margin. For a bundle of such covers, the local solutions glue whenever fixed reference deck transformations carry one local data set to another.
